## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy); confirmed by outsized Energy strength (PSX, MPC, VLO ABOVE TREND) and Financials showing ABOVE TREND names (JPM, CME), supporting a Value/Cyclical tilt.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.85% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.07% | 1M: +12.16%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate strong: EQIX (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND, VTR (1W: +4.88% | 1M: -5.25%) RECOVERY. Healthcare resilient: GILD (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +4.35% | 1M: +8.96%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Materials weak: CRH (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, SHW (1W: -5.25% | 1M: +6.70%) CORRECTION. Technology weak this week: META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -8.67% | 1M: +0.49%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary soft: GM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +10.44%) CORRECTION, ROST (1W: -6.13% | 1M: +0.25%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.85% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.07% | 1M: +12.16%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +5.30% | 1M: +6.90%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy), signaling cyclical concentration and Value/Cyclical style.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -8.67% | 1M: +0.49%) CORRECTION, CSCO (1W: -7.32% | 1M: +0.82%) CORRECTION, NOW (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +14.13%) CORRECTION, GM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +10.44%) CORRECTION — Weakness concentrated in Technology and select cyclicals; reduce exposure to beat-up high-multiple names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.85% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.07% | 1M: +12.16%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +5.30% | 1M: +6.90%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present among mega-caps (MSFT CORRECTION, AAPL RECOVERY, META BELOW TREND, AMZN CORRECTION) — tactical watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is mixed and lagging this week (1W: -1.94% | 1M: +6.61%; 24 stocks). NVDA (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +8.10%) ABOVE TREND and LRCX (1W: +5.30% | 1M: +6.90%) ABOVE TREND show pockets of strength, while META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -4.40% | 1M: +19.72%) CORRECTION highlight headline-driven volatility; sector breadth this week is negative.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are constructive (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +3.54%; 20 stocks). JPM (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +7.19%) ABOVE TREND, CME (1W: +4.71% | 1M: +10.78%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND underpin sector strength, supporting the Value/Cyclical tilt but watch firm-specific headlines (MS negative news).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing steady strength (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +6.01%; 17 stocks). GILD (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +12.03%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +4.35% | 1M: +8.96%) ABOVE TREND provide defensive ballast while UNH (1W: -2.05% | 1M: -6.55%) BELOW TREND is a clear outlier.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and select Financials and Healthcare exposure given narrow cyclical leadership; monitor concentration risk from Energy-heavy top performers. Reduce exposure to beaten-up mega-cap Tech where 1W weakness meets 1M dispersion (META BELOW TREND, AVGO CORRECTION, NOW CORRECTION). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt, but major-cap divergence argues for selectivity.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.85% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -8.67% | 1M: +0.49%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -4.40% | 1M: +19.72%) CORRECTION — watch for continuation or capitulation.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.66% | 10 stocks) and Financials (1W: +0.96% | 20 stocks) for cyclical follow-through. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.94% | 24 stocks) and Materials (1W: -3.04% | 11 stocks) for further downside risk; monitor Consumer Discretionary for spillovers.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch PSX holding its 1W breakout (sustained ABOVE TREND) as confirmation of Energy leadership; NVDA must sustain 1M gains to keep ABOVE TREND momentum. A failure of AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +1.68% | 1M: -4.99%) to hold the 1W pivot risks reversion, and JPM holding recent 1M gains would confirm Financial strength; a decisive break in META would deepen Tech downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GILD (+75): positive court ruling; GILD (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. PFE (+50): EMA filing validation; PFE (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +12.03%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-95): landmark trial headline; META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price align, large tail risk. UNH (-50): investor lawsuit; UNH (1W: -2.05% | 1M: -6.55%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. GM (-55): China pullback headline; GM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +10.44%) CORRECTION — short-term news aligns with 1W weakness but 1M strength signals distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.85% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND and GILD (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major-cap divergence and heavy negative news on META (-95) — monitor trend breaks and headline follow-through.
